# PeakLoads

> Free, offline-capable powerlifting warm-up planner and strength calculator suite for squat, bench press, deadlift, and overhead press.

- Canonical URL: https://peakloads.com/
- Languages: English, Turkish, Russian
- Units: Kilograms (2.5 kg plate rounding) and Pounds (5 lb plate rounding)
- Privacy: Client-side only (LocalStorage), no account required, no passive visitor tracking

## Core Tools
- [Warm-Up Planner](https://peakloads.com/#section-adv-warmup): 5-stage evidence-based warm-up progression (empty bar, 45%, 65%, 80%, 90%) with lift-specific technical cues for high-bar squat, low-bar squat, bench press, conventional deadlift, sumo deadlift, and overhead press.
- [Quick Warm-Up](https://peakloads.com/#section-warmup): Preset warm-up templates (Classic Ramp, Heavy Single Prep, Volume Builder).
- [1RM Estimator](https://peakloads.com/#section-1rm): One-rep max calculator supporting Epley, Brzycki, and Lombardi formulas.
- [Advanced 1RM Estimator](https://peakloads.com/#section-adv-1rm): RPE-calibrated 1RM calculator using the RTS percentage matrix (reps 1–10, RPE 6.5–10) with an asymptotic decay fallback.
- [Percentage Chart](https://peakloads.com/#section-percentage): Plate-ready working weight table generator from any base 1RM, range, and percentage increment.
- [RIR Translator](https://peakloads.com/#section-rir): Estimates 1RM from your last set's weight, reps, and Reps in Reserve (RIR) and calculates the target weight for your next set.
